summary: T7-03 round 4. All five story checks exit 0 on edbfe82. The round-3 blocker (codex-r3-1, the banner's own container) is fixed in page-check.ts through blockTree and bannerParts. I did not reproduce the gzip -9 initial-JS figure, because the command needs a loop or pipe. The only client module in the layout is site-header.tsx, and the build shows / as static. I read the code and the check results only. I did not run a mutation test of the nested-container fix myself; the round-3 resolution reports one.

checks.evidence: ruff, mypy, turbo lint and typecheck all succeeded: 'Tasks: 4 successful, 4 total'.
pytest: 404 passed. web: 11 files and 269 tests passed, including page-check.test.ts (50), mode-banner.test.tsx (14) and site-layout.test.tsx (32). schema: 157 passed.
The build succeeds. The route table shows ○ / and ○ /_not-found as static, so / is statically rendered.
Output: 'web-smoke: GET .../ (prerendered) shows the mock banner, "Shipping mode: not chosen (G0 NOT_RUN)" and bundle version mock-0 in the footer'.

checks.criterion: AC1: mode banner and mock banner texts, tested first
checks.evidence: mode-banner.tsx:17-21 builds the text from shellText and MODE_TITLES. The titles match PRD 4 by test. The 14 tests in mode-banner.test.tsx pass.

checks.criterion: AC2: layout renders skip link, mock banner, mode banner, nav, main and footer on every route
checks.evidence: layout.tsx:28-38 renders SkipLink, then the header with MockBanner, ModeBanner and SiteHeader, then main, then SiteFooter. The footer wording 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>' follows the documented orchestrator decision and the T0-05 smoke assertion. This is a low literal-reading difference only, already rebutted as claude-r2-1 and claude-r3-1.

checks.criterion: AC3: seven plain next/link links, none to /api/docs, /paper, /probe or /compare
checks.evidence: site-header.tsx:11-19 lists exactly Home, Moon, Mars, Earth, Model, Methods and Data, rendered with next/link.

checks.criterion: AC4: keyboard order, focus ring, aria-current
checks.evidence: site-header.tsx:27-34 sets aria-current='page' only when pathname equals href. The links are DOM-ordered anchors. The focus ring comes from the global rule and is covered by the site-layout tests, which pass.

checks.criterion: AC5: Mode C and B wording; / keeps its T0 texts plus one factual line
checks.evidence: The mode titles are the PRD 4 wording. page-check.ts:11 defines the single HOME_LINE, and the main equality at :223-227 allows only the title plus that line.

checks.criterion: AC6: build-time bundle read, / static, web-smoke still passes
checks.evidence: The smoke test passes and / shows ○ static in the build output.

checks.criterion: AC7: page-check updated test-first, main-only 'only these texts', protected texts asserted exactly, no other check weakened
checks.evidence: In page-check.ts the mock banner and the mode banner are compared as the whole text of their block, their container and their live region (:153-175). The footer is compared exactly (:210-216). Main is compared exactly (:223-227). The once-only 'Shipping mode:' count (:206-209) and the mock-in-production guard in lib/bundle.ts are unchanged. page-check.test.ts has 50 passing tests.

checks.criterion: AC8: site-header.tsx is the only client component; initial JS vs 173,974 B baseline and under 250 kB
checks.evidence: Only site-header.tsx has 'use client', and layout.tsx, the banners and the footer are server components; I saw this in the files. I did not reproduce the gzip -9 initial-JS measurement, because the command needs a shell loop or pipe that the review permission rules forbid. The author's figure of 177,190 B (+3,216 B, under 250 kB) is unverified by me.

findings.claim: AC2 says the footer reads 'Bundle <bundle_version>', but the footer reads 'Bundle version: <v> · Schema <v>'.
findings.evidence: It follows the orchestrator decision of 2026-11-14T21:24:28Z and T0-05's smoke assertion, which make web-smoke still passes. It is a literal-reading difference only, and the author rebutted it earlier as claude-r2-1 and claude-r3-1.

findings.claim: I did not reproduce the gzip -9 measurement of the initial JavaScript on /.
findings.evidence: The command needs a loop or pipe, which the review permissions forbid. The build shows / as static and site-header.tsx is the only client module in the story's files. The author's figure of 177,190 B is within the 250 kB budget.
